references.text: The first census of the Levites also showed 22,000 men from one month and upward, which here is increased to 23,000.
The Levites were not counted together with the other Israelites because they had a special service at the tabernacle.
The Lord explains that the Levites should have no inheritance in the land because the Lord himself was their inheritance, and they were to live from the tithes.
The tribe of Levi received no inheritance along with its brothers; the Lord is their inheritance.
Levitical priests were to have no inheritance in Israel; the Lord is their inheritance.
Only the tribe of Levi received no inheritance; the offerings of the Lord were their inheritance.
The Levites received no part of the land, only cities to live in with pasture grounds.
Ezekiel confirms that the Levites shall have no inheritance in the land; the Lord is their inheritance.
